sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Arjun Singh Somvanshi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Arjun Singh Somvanshi, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Manoj
Kumar Sahu, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
201 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Prohibition
Act, registered at Police Station Pali, District Hardoi.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 31.05.2022 against the applicant and his cousin's son Deepak, stating that the informant had got his daughter aged about 23 years married to the applicant's son five years ago; that the accused persons used to harass her for demanding dowry and at about 9:00 pm on 30.05.2022, the accused persons killed her by setting her ablaze.
4.

In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is a 60 years innocent person, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused Deepak alias Dhairya Pratap Singh, has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 26.04.2023 passed by a coordinate bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 11352 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 11352 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is father-in-law of the deceased; deceased got married five years ago; the F.I.R contains similar allegation against two accused persons and the co-accused Deepak has already been granted bail, coupled with the fact that the applicant is a 60 years old person having no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 09.06.2022 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
10. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
